name: I-ki-na-ri Iinazuke! ~Hime-sama no Okoshiire~
original_name: い・き・な・り・許嫁！～姫様のお輿入れ～
source:
Main character lives alone and spends his days in the company of his childhood friend. One day a girl barges in declaring that she was chosen to be protagonist's bride by the parents long ago. The girl decides to live together for three months and try to reinstall the marriage plans.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角獨自生活，平日由青梅竹馬陪伴。某天，一名少女突然闖進家門，宣稱雙方父母早已選定她做主角的新娘。少女決定與他共同生活三個月，努力設法讓這門婚事成真。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
